=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:228-240 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `.github/ai/` overlay block runs on every wrapper call, whether or not `--tests-file` is passed, so every existing caller (implement, review autofix, conflict resolver, heal, integration-repair) gets a different default-path `/source` snapshot. The block's `install ... || { synthetic_result snapshot_failed; exit 0; }` also adds a new abort path. The companion test edits in tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py lines 855, 862, 870-871 lock this changed behaviour in.
  WHY: This breaks "Existing callers and the default path are unchanged" and "strictly additive". Tests that read those files can switch between caused and inherited, and one `install` failure returns `snapshot_failed` to callers that never passed `--tests-file`. The editor summary said the block was removed and the test edits reverted, but neither change landed. Severity disagreement: gemini BLOCKER; sonnet, minimax and glm MAJOR. The highest is used.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:228-240 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The overlay loop copies tracked top-level `.github/ai/*` worktree files into `${root}/source`, including uncommitted edits. It skips the `review_untrusted_workspace.py` `allowed()` name rules (lines 137-138: `secret`/`credential`, `.env*`, `.pem`/`.key`/`.p12`/`.pfx`/`.keystore`) and the `.github` dot-subtree rule (lines 152-153).
  WHY: Secret- or credential-named files that the snapshot filter would exclude reach `/source`, where tests can read them and a failing test's output can carry them into the gate result. The impact is bounded: the container runs with `--network none` and only result.json and summary.md are copied back. Severity disagreement: minimax (SECURITY) and luna MAJOR; sonnet, glm and minimax (IMPLICIT-EXECUTION) NIT. The highest is used.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:821-831 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The rc 4/5 exception for `tests_file_nodes` units in `classify_baseline` checks only the baseline rc. `run_units` (line 687, `{**units[index], **future.result()}`) overwrites the PR-tree `rc` with the baseline one.
  WHY: A named node that is missing on both trees (pytest exit 4/5 on both), or a baseline rc 4 from an unrelated cause such as a conftest import failure, is left out of `inherited_ids`. It is reported as `status=fail` caused by the change, so a repair or heal run gets triggered for nothing. Severity disagreement: glm NIT; the others MAJOR. The highest is used.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:102 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `--tests-file` case runs `shift 2` without checking that a value was supplied, so a trailing `--tests-file` with no path is mishandled.
  WHY: Under `set -uo pipefail` without `-e`, `shift 2` fails. luna and gemini say the parsing loop then repeats forever; minimax says the wrapper exits with the wrong non-zero rc. Either way, the synthetic `usage_error` result is never produced. Severity disagreement: gemini MAJOR; minimax and luna NIT. The highest is used. sonnet raised the same pattern only as a hardening suggestion.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:584-614 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `plan_units` drops `--tests-file` `::name` filters without notice and runs the whole file in two cases. One is the `.ai/validate.yml` `prepush_test_command` override at lines 584-589, which builds `{files}` from `entry["path"]` only. The other is the `.py` `__main__` fallback at lines 613-614 (`argv: ["python3", path]`). Neither adds an `unverified` marker.
  WHY: This violates "runs exactly the listed files and `::name` entries": failures from unlisted tests show up as caused or inherited with no diagnostic. The override case is documented in the agents fragment; the `__main__` case is not.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  expected_change_site: scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh, default-path snapshot assembly (delete the `.github/ai/` overlay block at lines 228-240); tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py, `test_wrapper_lists_uncommitted_tracked_edits_and_overlays_command_inputs` (revert lines 855, 862, 870-871)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

No hunk removes the overlay block, which is still at lines 228-240. tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py:855 still commits `.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json`, :862 still captures `ls -a "$src/.github/ai"`, and :870-871 still assert `"label_contract.v1.json" in listing`. The previous editor summary claims "removed the `.github/ai/` snapshot overlay" and "reverted the edit", but neither change is on PR head (7f54506f).
- requirement: "`--tests-file` runs exactly the listed files and `::name` entries." (linked issue #8461 Acceptance criteria)
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, `plan_units()` (custom `prepush_test_command` override and the `__main__` Python runner fallback)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Lines 584-589 build `{files}` from `entry["path"]` only and discard `functions`. Line 613-614 emits `argv: ["python3", path]` without using `names`. In both cases there is no `unverified` marker and no test covers the case. The agents.d fragment documents the override case but not the `.py` fallback. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly did not count this as a gap.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:lines 228-240 (`.github/ai/` overlay loop) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The loop copies every tracked top-level `.github/ai/*` worktree file into `/source` after the `review_untrusted_workspace.py` credential-filtered snapshot. Names that filter excludes (`*secret*`, `*credential*`, `.env*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`) are still copied, and so are uncommitted edits.
  WHY: This is a hygiene gap, not an exfiltration path, because of `--network none` and the merge-base `git archive` baseline. Removing the block closes it.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:lines 228-240; tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py lines 855, 862 and 870-871 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The overlay block is still present and is gated only on `.github/ai` existing, not on `tests_file_given`, so it runs on every wrapper call. The editor summary claiming it was removed and the test reverted is wrong.
  WHY: Every existing caller gets a different PR-tree snapshot, tests can switch between caused and inherited, and an `install` failure returns `snapshot_failed`. This contradicts "Existing callers and the default path are unchanged". Fix: delete lines 228-240 and restore the test lines 855, 862 and 870-871.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:`classify_baseline`, lines 821 and 828-831 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `run_units` (line 687) overwrites the PR-tree `rc` with the baseline `rc`, so the exception looks only at the baseline. Two cases are no longer counted as inherited: a named unit that exits 4/5 on both trees (a stale `::name`, since `parse_tests_file` never checks the name exists), and a baseline that exits 4 from a conftest import failure.
  WHY: A failure present on both trees lands in `failures` with `status=fail`. Fix: record `pr_rcs = {u["id"]: u.get("rc") for u in rerun}` and require `pr_rcs.get(unit["id"]) not in (4, 5)`.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:`plan_units`, lines 584-589 and lines 613-614 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `::name` filters are dropped without notice for the `prepush_test_command` override and for the `python3 path` `__main__` fallback, with no unverified marker. Only the override case is documented.
  WHY: The whole file runs, which breaks "runs exactly the listed files and `::name` entries". Fix: append `{"item": path, "reason": "tests_file_names_ignored"}` to `unverified`.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:lines 228-240 (NAMING / BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The block changes the default-path snapshot contents, which header steps 4-6 document as filtered through `review_untrusted_workspace.py`, in a PR meant to be additive only.
  WHY: Callers that pass no new flags see a different `/source` tree.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: "`scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh`: add `--tests-file <path>` ... Existing callers and the default path are unchanged." (Scope 2), "It is strictly additive" (Scope 1).
  Expected change site: scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh `.github/ai/` overlay at lines 228-240; tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py `test_wrapper_lists_uncommitted_tracked_edits_and_overlays_command_inputs` (lines 855, 862, 870-871)
  Evidence of absence: The last-run diff touches only the header comment (line 33) and the size-check split (lines 161-168). No hunk removes the overlay or reverts the test edits.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items), HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
  - workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py `classify_baseline` ~lines 821-831: capture `pr_rcs` before `run_units` and add `and pr_rcs.get(unit["id"]) not in (4, 5)` (2 lines).
  - scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh line 102: a trailing `--tests-file` makes `shift 2` fail and the `while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]` loop never ends. This pattern already exists for every flag. Fix: `[ "$#" -ge 2 ] || { synthetic_result usage_error; exit 0; }` (1 line).
